text: She is the elected representative of our whole street.
translation: 她是我们整条街选出的代表。
note: 选出来的人 = 众议员

text: Every worker sent a representative to the meeting.
translation: 每位员工派了一名代表去开会。
note: 派人参会 = 众议员/代表

text: The new representative spoke for an hour.
translation: 新代表讲了一个小时。

text: He met the representative before the vote.
translation: 他在投票前见了那位代表。
note: 投票前会见 = 众议员

text: That representative map shows every small road.
translation: 那幅有代表性的地图画出了每条小路。
note: 有代表性的 = 描写的

text: She gave a representative example of good work.
translation: 她举了一个关于出色工作的代表性例子。

text: His face is not representative of the whole class.
translation: 他的脸不代表全班。

text: Choose a representative word from these thirty.
translation: 从这三十个里挑一个典型的词。

text: His performance was a poor representative of his skill.
translation: 他的表现没有代表出他的水平。
note: 表现代表水平 = 表现的

text: Choose a colour that is representative of the sea.
translation: 选一个能代表大海的颜色。
note: 代表性地体现 = 表现的

text: That number is not representative of our whole year.
translation: 那个数字不能代表我们全年。
note: 有代表性的数据 = 表现的

text: The final result was representative of ten years of work.
translation: 最终结果体现了十年的工作。

text: She acts as our representative at every meeting.
translation: 她在每次会议上都当我们的代表。

text: He is the company representative in the north.
translation: 他是公司驻北方的代理。

text: I will send my representative to talk to them.
translation: 我会派我的代表去和他们谈。

text: Their representative agreed to all our terms.
translation: 他们的代表同意了我们的全部条件。

text: The people sent one more representative to the seat.
translation: 民众又向议会送了一名代表。

text: Take one representative case and learn it well.
translation: 挑一个典型的案例学透。

text: Her answer was not representative of her real skill.
translation: 她的回答没有体现出她真正的水平。

text: Their representative signed the paper in ten minutes.
translation: 他们的代理十分钟内签了文件。
